overall_notes: This paper is about instruction-following text embedding, not NLG evaluation. The core contribution is a framework (GSTransform) for efficiently adapting pre-computed embeddings to user instructions. While LLMs are used for intermediate data generation, the paper evaluates embedding quality using standard metrics (V-measure, Spearman correlation, Triplet Alignment Accuracy) on embedding tasks, not NLG outputs. The initial extraction incorrectly classified this as an NLG paper.
